title: (No AI) The nation’s largest school districts consider ditching Google Search
author: Terrence O’Brien
content:
![Vector illustration of the Gemini logo.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2025/01/STK255_Google_Gemini_D.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

New York, Los Angeles, and Chicago schools are considering Google alternatives after the company said it will disable Search for schools that opt out of its AI features, according to _[The New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/18/technology/google-gemini-ai-search-schools-nyc-la-chicago.html)_. Starting next year, schools will not have the option to disable Gemini-powered features without also disabling Search. Chris Phillips, Google's vice president of education, told the _[Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/03/us/google-search-schools-restrict-ai.html?unlocked_article_code=1.NlE.VMKr.Cr-g-C6phyfH)_ that, "Search and AI are deeply integrated," and that schools that turn off Google's AI features "will not have access to Search."

Many elected officials, including New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani and Senator Bernie Sanders, responded harshly, calling Go …

title: (No AI) Trump’s latest land grab is an AI hub in the Philippines
author: Justine Calma
content:
![soldiers line up around President Trump as he walks away from a plane.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/11/gettyimages-2305507602.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

President Donald Trump is welcomed upon his arrival at Villamor Air Base on November 17th, 2026, in Manila, Philippines. | Photo: Getty Images

President Donald Trump was greeted by no less than five beauty queens when he landed in the Philippines on Tuesday, [according to local news outlet _Rappler_](https://www.rappler.com/philippines/trump-arrives-state-visit-asean-special-summit-2026/). As he [stepped onto the tarmac](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Nbg8xDnxELo), a child handed him small US and Philippine flags. A band played "YMCA," a staple at Trump rallies, as more girls in traditional bell-sleeved blouses and young men in wide-brimmed hats danced to the song.

Outside the airport, hundreds of protesters [packed streets](https://www.cnn.com/2026/11/17/world/video/trump-asia-philippines-visit-intldsk) bearing signs - and at least one prop casket - saying "Trump out." Others say "Reject Pax Silica," the name for the US-led international initiative to secure chips and critical minerals used in the …
